feedback.delta: Persona/capability declarations are context, not authority. Keep runtime capability health and effect permission external and typed.
Test ask_before under default allow, exact-vs-prefix tool matching, unknown tool names and semantic-safe prompt truncation.
Policy result must be DENY|REQUIRE_APPROVAL|ALLOW; exact match by default, wildcard only when explicit; EffectIntent execution requires external capability/approval receipt.
Persist policy hash/version, matched rule, decision class, approval/capability receipt and verified effect outcome for replay.
Workspace/persona salience cannot authorize effects. Broadcast/use/re-entry remain distinct from authorization.
Emergent self-model coherence or repeated capability self-report must never raise permission level.
Keep versioned last-known-good persona recovery; reject prompt-owned authority and raw character truncation of control semantics.
